pages.text: $(l:lumen_glade)Lumen Glade$(/l) — gentle blue-green meadows.$(br)$(l:glowroot_forest)Glowroot Forest$(/l) — dense, dim woods of giant self-lit trees.$(br)$(l:glasspetal_crags)Glasspetal Crags$(/l) — blue-violet crystal highlands.$(br)$(l:sporefall_jungle)Sporefall Jungle$(/l) — lush rainforest of giant glowing mushrooms.

$(l:moonmire)Moonmire$(/l) — a glowing swamp of Lumenwater pools.$(br)$(l:undercrown_caverns)Undercrown Caverns$(/l) — the deep cave biome, lit by crystal ore and hanging glowvine.$(br)$(l:stillbloom_basin)Stillbloom Basin$(/l) — a rare, bright sanctuary of giant Stillbloom flowers.$(br)$(br)Overhead, all of it lies under $(l:veyra)Veyra$(/l).
